item.title: Write smoke test script for regression checking
item.intent: Create a simple bash smoke test that runs every command in safe mode — run after every change to catch regressions, required before any refactoring begins
steps: Create .aishore/tests/smoke.sh that runs bash -n then every command in safe/dry-run mode
Include: help, version, backlog list, status, config check, diagnose, run --dry-run, auto done --dry-run, metrics, report, update --dry-run, clean --dry-run
Exit non-zero on first failure with clear error message
acceptanceCriteria: bash .aishore/tests/smoke.sh passes on current clean codebase
Script exits non-zero and names the failing command on any regression
